name: boksa
description: Chrome extension that copies a selection of rendered Markdown as rich HTML with the page's computed styles inlined.

scripts.package: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist/boksa && cp -R manifest.json background.js color.js copy.js options.html options.js README.md PRIVACY.md LICENSE icons _locales dist/boksa/ && cd dist && zip -qr ../boksa-$npm_package_version.zip boksa && echo "built boksa-$npm_package_version.zip"
scripts.package:store: npm run package && cd dist/boksa && zip -qr ../../boksa-store-$npm_package_version.zip . && echo "built boksa-store-$npm_package_version.zip (manifest at archive root, for Web Store upload)"
